correctness.rationale: The graph uses right multiplication by the stated reduced words, and the two radius-4 metrics are not interchangeable. Independent reduced-word enumeration gave 0 closed length-3 and 66 closed length-4 products, none non-backtracking. The displayed five distinct vertices form a cycle, proving girth 5. There are 10 oriented rooted traversals, or 5 unoriented cycles through e, of length 5 and none at lengths 3,4,6; the frozen verify_final.py counts ordered tuples, so 10 is valid in its traversal convention. Independent output /workspace/branches/edc8fc56-be3b-446c-940b-03a0196aad74/independent_result.txt reproduces the girth and ball results. Separately checked the archived JSON colorings against independently generated balls and all internal edges: tree B4 has (161,177) vertices/edges and classes 93/54/14, S-ball r=4 has (833,953) and classes 398/319/116, both root 0 and no conflicts. Tree B5 has (485,537). The C5 lies in B4, so the coloring shows χ=3 there; copying a proper rooted coloring cannot lose the literal partial-color game. A direct ordinary coloring of all of G_S is obtained by sending a,b to (12),(23) in S₃ and using the three cosets gH with H={1,(13)} as colors. Indeed no image of a step lies in H, including the two commutator images, which are 3-cycles. This also proves the B5 coloring assertion and excludes any cutoff at depth 5 for the same literal game. Neither the finite checks nor this group coloring is a coloring on the free shift with Borel or measurable regularity.

value.rationale: The proposed significance is a finite cutoff for a possible Borel-versus-measurable gap. But the literal game only tests restrictions of ordinary colorings, and the simple S₃-coset coloring wins at every depth on every ball or finite subset, not merely at the purported commutator scale. Thus the depth-4 no-go is not an informative horizon or a barrier to a meaningful lifting of a Marks game. The remaining small girth and ball counts have no identified use independent of that purpose, and do not constrain the proposed Borel/measurable gap. A wording repair or substitution of the elementary global ordinary coloring would not provide the missing substantive connection.
